title: Uncertainty-preserving corpus parsing
summary: Count format violations, alternative readings and token exclusions under explicit policies.
assumptions: Locus IDs and alphabet metadata are correctly interpreted.
controls: Synthetic malformed and foldout fixtures; raw byte hashes; alternative-space variants.
limitations: Cannot decide which reading is correct or identify language units.
cost: CPU-scale initial protocol or small manual evidence audit; declare exact budget before expanding.
